spec_match.rationale: Exercises the exact new grammar (::highlight(*)) through both CSS.supports('selector(…)') and an enforcing insertRule probe, layered on real registered highlights rather than a mock.

interactive.rationale: Inject, per-name-fallback toggle, and clear buttons all mutate live adopted stylesheets over three real Range-backed highlights with a readout of the parser's actual verdict.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises registered highlights plus a constructed-stylesheet parse verdict with a labelled fallback; the page delivers all three.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the SyntaxError rejection path (the feature's only failure surface), the no-registry-at-all branch, and the supports-vs-insertRule agreement check.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5174965228929024 and the css-pseudo-4 selector definition.

conformance.rationale: The new suite pins the same contracts: named parse, supports(selector), insertRule acceptance, zero-specificity, registry round-trip, priority.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 (cloud fallback, no chrome-devtools-mcp): named highlights painted and read back via getComputedStyle (rgb(253,232,232) / rgb(232,216,255)); inject threw SyntaxError with the honest message; fallback measured textDecorationStyle 'dotted' on ::highlight(demo-grammar); clear restored; zero console errors; both viewports screenshotted.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts registry population, the accepted branch, the rejected branch tied to the supports probe, fallback toggles, and the registry-missing fallback.

design_system.rationale: All colours are tokens (highlight backgrounds fde8e8/dbeafe/e8d8ff under black text, AA+), buttons 44px, pressed state outlined, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons with visible focus and aria-pressed where stateful, readout and banner are role=status aria-live, legend is aria-hidden decoration while the readout carries the text equivalent, highlights never convey unexplained meaning alone.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800: zero horizontal overflow, controls wrap, identical probe results.

openQuestions.title: Capture the accepted-branch evidence on a 158+/flagged engine
openQuestions.detail: On Chromium with CSSCustomHighlightUniversalSelector active, the inject button should report acceptance and the dotted underline + stone background should appear via the single universal rule (visible in a screenshot and via getComputedStyle textDecorationStyle on all three names). Record that evidence and confirm supports() and insertRule still agree.

guidanceConsulted.query: highlight text ranges in page without extra DOM spans
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Collect text nodes with a TreeWalker, set Range start/end on text nodes (never innerHTML), register via CSS.highlights, and cache the node list for static content.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: rangesFor() walks the sample paragraph with a TreeWalker once at load and sets ranges on the text nodes; no wrapper spans exist (the page invites DOM inspection to prove it).

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel toggle buttons no horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Let control rows wrap with flex-wrap and gap; avoid fixed widths.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Controls use flex-wrap:wrap with gap tokens; verified 0px overflow at 360px including the long flag-name banner (overflow-wrap:anywhere).

summary: The shipped Custom Highlight surface demonstrated for real (three Range-backed highlights painting, verified by pseudo-element computed-style readback) with the one new grammar probed exactly: insertRule SyntaxError + CSS.supports false on Chromium 141, per-name fallback measured working. Cloud headless verification, both viewports clean.
